mapper.select: SELECT * FROM global_script_file ORDER BY file_type, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO global_script_file (file_name, file_path, file_type, description, is_executable, auto_backup, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{description}, #{isExecutable}, #{autoBackup}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
